text: Loons and creating preliminary annotations. We start with a frame from the drone footage. Instead of drawing every bounding box from scratch, the researcher reviews what the model already identified. If a prediction is correct, they simply accept it. If a box isn't positioned correctly, they move or resize it. And if the model detects something that isn't a loon, they reject it. As we collect more real drone footage and researchers correct the model's predictions, those corrected annotations become additional training data.
